# Run the analysis

From the main project folder, run:

```bash
Rscript scripts/R/run_workflow.R data/synthetic results/synthetic
```

This repeats the input checks, fits DESeq2 and reproduces the figures you previewed. Keep bundled inputs unchanged for the first run. Rerunning replaces the named outputs; resolve any error before interpreting a partially refreshed folder.

## Understand the analysis

| Step | What the script does | What to check |
|---|---|---|
| Sample summaries | Sums supplied raw counts and counts nonzero genes | These are not overall FASTQ or alignment quality metrics |
| Filtering | Keeps genes with counts ≥10 in at least two samples | Filtered and original gene counts can differ |
| Model | Fits `~ donor + group` | Contrast is B versus A, accounting for donor; positive effects indicate the first condition |
| Inference | Estimates size factors, dispersions and condition effects; adjusts p-values | Inspect `lfcSE`, `pvalue`, `padj` and unavailable values |
| Exploration | Variance-stabilizes retained counts for PCA and distances | These values are not used as differential testing inputs; donor effects remain |
| Gene display | Plots the post-analysis selected gene alongside two prespecified examples | The first gene is selected after fitting; the other examples are fixed before analysis. Neither display independently confirms p-values |

## Find the six figures

All filenames below are inside `results/synthetic/figures/`.

| File | Inspect |
|---|---|
| `library-sizes.png` | Raw count totals for every sample |
| `sample-pca.png` | Condition colours, donor shapes, pair connections and axis percentages |
| `sample-distances.png` | Distances between transformed sample profiles |
| `ma-plot.png` | Average expression versus unshrunken log2 fold change |
| `volcano.png` | Unshrunken log2 fold change versus -log10(adjusted p-value) |
| `selected-gene.png` | Three normalized-count panels across paired conditions |

MA and volcano plots use the original, unshrunken log2 fold-change estimates. Inspect their uncertainty in `lfcSE`. The volcano omits missing adjusted p-values and floors zero values only for plotting. Colour uses `padj < 0.05` without an effect-size cutoff.

## Find the supporting numbers

All TSVs below are inside `results/synthetic/tables/`.

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `sample-qc.tsv` | Raw total and detected-gene count for each sample |
| `differential-expression.tsv` | Model estimates, standard errors, p-values and adjusted p-values |
| `normalized-counts.tsv` | Retained raw counts divided by DESeq2 size factors |
| `size-factors.tsv` | Size factor used for each sample |
| `transformed-counts.tsv` | Variance-stabilized retained counts |
| `pca-scores.tsv`, `pca-variance.tsv` | Sample coordinates and percentages explained |
| `sample-distances.tsv` | Numerical distances behind the heatmap |
| `selected-gene-counts.tsv` | Gene ID and normalized values for the post-analysis selected gene |
| `example-gene-counts.tsv` | Values and example labels for all three expression panels |
| `input-script-hashes.tsv` | Hashes identifying the exact inputs and workflow script |

`run-log.txt` records the design, contrast, filtering, selected gene and software versions. `session-info.txt` records the R session. Compare these records before investigating differences from bundled previews; software versions may affect final numerical values.

**Checkpoint:** open all six figures, locate the selected gene in the DE table and confirm the contrast in the run log. Return to the preview page and explain what each figure shows using your own generated outputs.
